scope: Recovered historical generic components were statically screened and evaluated in public-training leave-one-out folds. This is an exclusion measurement, not a production solver evaluation.

data.eligibility: After holding one public training pair out, at least three training pairs remained.

method.fold_input: The held-out pair's input was the only test input. Its output was withheld from fit and prediction and used only for scoring.
method.fit_gate: Each component's own full fit gate was applied to the remaining training examples.
method.prediction: Each component's predict method was called on the fold. No task ID or hidden/evaluation solution was supplied.

decision.reason: The strict component fit gates produced no predictions in any eligible fold. These candidates have no measured coverage for integration and are excluded from the next submission candidate.

limits: Only the three generic components exposed by the statically screened v31 factory were evaluated.
This result does not measure every component in the recovered historical bundle or the current HDS solver.
The official test solutions and evaluation solutions were not read.
